short: Opened China, ended the draft, and resigned rather than face certain impeachment.
full:
Nixon withdrew American ground forces from Vietnam under the policy of Vietnamisation while widening the air war into Cambodia and Laos; the Paris accords of January 1973 ended American involvement. He went to Beijing in February 1972, the first president to visit the People's Republic, and signed the SALT I arms limitation agreement in Moscow three months later. At home he created the Environmental Protection Agency, ended conscription, and took the dollar off gold in 1971.

Five men were arrested inside the Democratic headquarters at the Watergate complex in June 1972. The cover-up ran through the White House, and the taping system Nixon had installed recorded him directing it. The Supreme Court compelled release of the tapes in July 1974; with impeachment certain, he resigned effective noon on 9 August, the only president to do so.
